epic.title: Epic 568: engine state has an owner - leases, rails, gauge, dispatch
epic.intent_and_why: Every piece of engine state carries who it belongs to and dies when its owner does. This run builds the ownership substrate (WP1 lease lifecycle, WP2 binding store, WP5 postcondition cwd) that the deferred consumer packages read from. The outcome that must not be violated: the engine stays drivable throughout, because this epic edits the machinery every Commander in it is driving.

definition_of_done: Each in-scope issue closes on a live repro that fails before the fix and passes after.
A stated honest null closes an issue as a complete deliverable.
The engine remains drivable by the fleet at every wave boundary.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Repro before and after, plus targeted automated tests and the relevant broader suite per docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: A demonstrated repro plus a green suite measured on merged main.
good_enough.appetite: One tranche: WP1 + WP2 + WP5 + issues 530 and 510. Consumer packages WP3, WP4, WP6, WP7 deferred.

hard_constraints: Engine-core files scripts/checklist_engine.py, scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py and scripts/agent_work_root.py are edited by ONE Commander at a time; concurrent edits to them are refused.
Planning makes no direct gh or network mutation.
Merge only on a green check exit code plus an independent reviewer APPROVE, gating on the exit code and never chaining a merge onto a watch command.
fixed_decisions: Wave 1 is issue 315 alone, ahead of all other engine-core work.
Launched identities remain stable across a transition.
The contract expires at wave 1 merge; nothing past wave 1 is a launch queue.

current_wave.objective: Remove the fail-open in command-kind postcondition checks and repair the corpus-wide blast radius that removing it exposes.
exit_criteria: A repro shows a decoy file in the launcher's directory satisfying a gate before the fix, and failing to satisfy it after.
Every shipped template carrying a relative command check is enumerated BY COMMAND with a stated count, and each is repaired or explicitly ruled correct under the new resolution.
The relevant broader suite is green on merged main.

issues.title: engine: command-kind checks inherit the launcher's cwd (no cwd= at all) - five shipped relative checks are silently fragile
issues.desired_outcome: A command-kind postcondition check runs where the spine lives, not where the launcher happened to stand, and every relative check in the shipped corpus resolves correctly under that change.
issues.useful_now: Every gate verified before this fix lands was verified under a check that cannot fail, so every later fix in this epic would inherit unfalsifiable evidence.
issues.appetite: One Commander, serialized engine-core lane, Opus tier.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A live repro that fails before and passes after, plus a by-command enumeration of every shipped template carrying a relative command check with its count stated.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose how cwd is threaded and where it is resolved from; preserve the existing POSIX-shell routing and the no-posix-shell visible-failure behavior at checklist_engine.py:775-799.
hard_constraints_no_gos: No concurrent Commander may edit scripts/checklist_engine.py during this wave.
Do not silently reword the frozen four transcribed clauses in references/global-everyone.md.
local_unknowns: How many shipped templates carry a relative command check - the issue title says five, which is a claim to re-measure, not to inherit.

wave_evidence.claim: Threading cwd into command checks disarms the worktree-isolation gate.
wave_evidence.expected: Setting cwd makes a relative check resolve against the spine's repo root.
wave_evidence.observed: verify_worktree_isolation.py:100-123 _git() runs subprocess.run(['git', *args]) with no cwd=, so current_toplevel() measures the AMBIENT cwd as the check's subject. Forcing cwd=<repo-root> makes the comparison X == X and turns COMMANDER_SPINE's init.c0 into a tautology.
wave_evidence.source: Admiral's own read of the source, plus an independent reviewer who rebuilt the red-first proof, plus a landed guard proven red against the naive fix

wave_evidence.claim: The filed count of relative checks is wrong.
wave_evidence.expected: Five shipped relative checks, per the issue title.
wave_evidence.observed: 22 command checks in skills templates: 6 literal-relative, 11 cwd-defaulting, 5 no-path. 17 cwd-dependent. The .agent-work template corpus measures 15 of 21.
wave_evidence.source: enumerate_checks.py re-run by the Admiral over both corpora; reproduces the Commander's table cell for cell

wave_evidence.claim: The claimed immunity is concentrated in dead run scrap.
wave_evidence.expected: 394 checked-in checks already carry cd <abs> && and are immune, making the fix largely inert.
wave_evidence.observed: Of 1733 command checks in tracked JSON, 1649 sit in .agent-work/archive/ and will never run again; 355 of those carry cd. The LIVE template corpus has 64 command checks and ZERO carry cd.
wave_evidence.source: Admiral's scan over git ls-files '*.json', bucketed by archive vs live templates

wave_evidence.claim: The value the engine would need is already computed at init and thrown away.
wave_evidence.expected: The repo root is unknown to the engine and must be passed in.
wave_evidence.observed: init_work_area.py:148 substitutes <repo-root> with Path(root).resolve().as_posix(), then discards it. spine_lifecycle.py:83 build_origin() already returns a block carrying work_id, branch, worktree, base, opened_at, opened_by, parent. open_work() already stamps it.

wave_evidence.claim: The designed mechanism is unused everywhere.
wave_evidence.observed: 0 of 107 tracked spine.json files carry an origin block, and checklist_engine.py never reads one -- its only 'origin' is the git ref origin/main.

discrepancies.signal: The wave's stated fix cannot land: threading cwd into command checks disarms the worktree-isolation gate, whose subject IS the ambient cwd.
discrepancies.evidence: verify_worktree_isolation.py:100-123; a landed guard proven red against the naive fix; independent reviewer reproduction.
discrepancies.reason: The current wave's exit criteria named a before/after repro of the fix; the fix as scoped is falsified, so the wave must be repaired rather than advanced.

discrepancies.signal: The human rejected all three Commander options and set a fourth direction: the spine records its own repo reference at creation, rather than the engine taking an argument.
discrepancies.evidence: build_origin() and open_work() already implement it; init_work_area.py already computes the resolved root and discards it; 0 of 107 spines carry origin.
discrepancies.reason: This re-cuts what work package 5 is and pulls spine-init discipline into scope, so the decomposition changes.

discrepancies.signal: The disciplined spine-init path is reachable only through the spine_open MCP door, which is dead in this session.
discrepancies.evidence: mcp__spine-epic__spine_open returned MCP error -32000 Connection closed; the Admiral consequently used init_work_area.py plus a hand-run git worktree add, and this epic's own spine carries no origin.
discrepancies.reason: A direction that depends on the disciplined init path cannot be adopted while that path is unreachable, so it is blocking evidence the repair must settle.

discrepancies.signal: The contract's merge gate is unsatisfiable: it requires a green check exit code, and main's CI is red from pre-existing Windows breakage.
discrepancies.evidence: gh pr checks 576 exits 1; main's last five runs failed including base 3e4e07a3; main and PR failure sets are identical at 76 each with zero regressions and two added passing tests.
discrepancies.reason: The wave cannot reach a merge under the contract as written, so the blocker must be settled before the wave can close.

discrepancies.signal: The claimed 394-check immunity is concentrated in archived run scrap rather than live templates.
discrepancies.evidence: 1649 of 1733 command checks sit under .agent-work/archive/; the live template corpus has 64 checks and zero carry a cd prefix.
discrepancies.reason: It removes the main argument for closing 315 as not-worth-it, but implies no separate work item of its own.
